# Local adaptation log

Upstream snapshot imported from `grimygunnz/nvidia-3070-VI` commit `6e9c1dd9fb32daaa855f446560a4d1f8df5f8424` (2026-11-26). Its original `LICENSE` is retained. The file list and upstream Git blob IDs are in `.source-manifest.json`.

Upstream `main` later advanced to `25ff2168267d967c5e428f94726a7384e59cd5b7`. That commit changes only `docs/nvidia-8gb.md`; the local copy of that file is synchronized to its blob `083f560cfa9dc798d16c1924f3b13ed062f1da10`. No runtime source changed between these revisions.

## Local changes

- `crates/victory-formats/src/texture.rs`: parenthesize `(i * 7)` before shifting in a test fixture expression. This preserves Rust operator-precedence behavior and fixes the upstream CI's `clippy::precedence` error under `-D warnings` (runs `45877144008` and `45880961297`). The Windows MSVC build and workspace tests now pass; workspace Clippy remains to be run.
- `crates/victory-hle/src/modules/dstorage.rs` and `crates/victory-hle/Cargo.toml`: size the DirectStorage worker pool to the physical-core count, with an override (`VICTORY_DSTORAGE_WORKERS`, 1–64) and a fallback if Windows cannot report cores. Ported from [`fxceless/victory-fork#1044`](https://github.com/fxceless/victory-fork/pull/1044), authored by Key-rs. That open PR measured 5.7 ms/MB copy-back at 16 workers versus 2.4–3.5 ms/MB at 8 on a Ryzen 7 8845H / RTX 4060 Laptop. The target Ryzen 7 7700X has 8 physical / 16 logical cores; local FPS and copy timing remain unverified.
- `crates/victory-gpu/src/descriptor.rs`, `descriptor/host.rs`, and `draw.rs`: attach a unique host-heap ID to dynamic descriptor ranges and refuse releases whose ID does not match. Ported from merged [`fxceless/victory-fork#1324`](https://github.com/fxceless/victory-fork/pull/1324), authored by CwWwWwW. Added the upstream wrong-heap regression test. The local GPU library suite now passes, including this area. This guards stale releases after address reuse; it does not implement the separate in-flight descriptor-write deferral from `victory-unified`.
- `crates/victory-gpu/src/descriptor.rs`, `descriptor/host.rs`, and `host.rs`: defer null descriptor writes and resource release until submissions are idle, skip texture-view refreshes while submissions are flying, and only flush slots that have not been remade. Ported from [`Itsbatt/victory-unified@768735a`](https://github.com/Itsbatt/victory-unified/commit/768735ad589eb9951a5c8812c4675bbf3b9ed765); rationale, evidence limits, and test coverage are recorded in [`docs/UPSTREAM-CHANGE-768735A.md`](docs/UPSTREAM-CHANGE-768735A.md). Added a stale/remade-slot regression test. The Windows build and workspace tests now pass, including D3D12 host-device coverage; in-game stress and long-run stability remain unverified.
- `Play-VIctory.cmd`: use `%LOCALAPPDATA%\AstraForge\GameFiles` as the neutral default directory, and accept the local executable through `VICTORY_GAME_EXE` (default `game.exe`). No game files are added to the source repository.
- `apps/victory/src/run.rs`, `crates/victory-gpu/src/compose.rs`, and `crates/victory-hle/src/modules/{files,lifecycle}.rs`: use anonymous wording in comments and command examples. This changes no Rust behavior and keeps the technical offsets and rationale available for debugging.
- **Reverted 2026-11-27:** the change in the next item (`f8b6af5`) clamped shader view indices to slot 737,855. It left the 2^18 dynamic descriptors above that slot, so every per-draw table read null and the output was black. The working tree restores the original layout: the clamp is the last heap slot, and the dynamic slots follow the fitted title slots. Bisection with frame captures: `a0748dc` renders, `f8b6af5` is black, and the revert renders. Descriptor tests pass 51/1 ignored; shader tests pass 283/4 ignored.
- (reverted) `crates/victory-gpu/src/descriptor/host.rs` and `crates/victory-shader/src/emit/shader.rs`: move the shader null sentinel ahead of the fixed 2^18 dynamic-descriptor tail when the host view heap is capped at one million descriptors. The title-visible mirror ends before the sentinel, so an out-of-range title index cannot alias a live dynamic descriptor. This local correction was prompted by a model-assisted review and then confirmed by tracing heap sizing, shader clamping, resource retention, and slot release in source; it does not copy an upstream patch. Commit `f8b6af5`; the new layout regression test and GPU-library suite pass.
- `crates/victory-gpu/src/residency.rs`: initialize cached available commit to zero. If the first `GlobalMemoryStatusEx` call fails, speculative upload admission fails closed until a valid sample arrives instead of seeing `u64::MAX` headroom. Commit `42435bf`.
- `crates/victory-gpu/src/indirect.rs`: correct two test fixtures whose requested work left enough budget for the following dispatch or whose assertion incorrectly charged a rejected all-or-nothing job. Runtime shader behavior is unchanged. Commit `468b79b`.
- `crates/victory-gpu/src/descriptor.rs`: canonicalize placed-view shape keys before recording them. Resource-description padding words 1 and 13 are zeroed; SRV padding and union words unused by the selected SRV/UAV dimension are also zeroed, while unknown dimensions retain all words. This is a focused port of [`TaynanGT/Vice-Tay#27`](https://github.com/TaynanGT/Vice-Tay/pull/27), commits `f07e54a2` and `ce914907`; the resource-padding change credits `JMAN730/project-flamingo@b1e0cd1d`. It prevents unwritten bytes from consuming the 2^22 placed-shape namespace and forcing later placed views into permanent table entries. The two new canonicalization tests and all ten `descriptor::tests` pass locally. Runtime memory behavior and rendering remain unverified.
- `crates/victory-gpu/src/host.rs`: extend the existing `VICTORY_FILL_TITLE` control with mode `2`, which bypasses the short flight wait only when no shader write landed in that range during the last 600 frames. Mode `1` retains its prior predicate, and unset/unknown/`0` values keep waiting. Focused predicate tests pass. Ported selectively from [`TaynanGT/Vice-Tay@b6be7e3`](https://github.com/TaynanGT/Vice-Tay/commit/b6be7e3b0b2f7ead75ff999ae53e3021da17c7cb). It is off in all supplied profiles; runtime correctness and performance remain unmeasured on this PC.
- `crates/victory-gpu/src/shadow.rs`: saturate the first parallel `Shadow::differing` cut before clamping it to `from`. If a title range starts partway through a 64 KiB piece, the previous unsigned subtraction wrapped: debug builds panicked and release builds could skip the first comparison slice. Ported from [`TaynanGT/Vice-Tay#114`](https://github.com/TaynanGT/Vice-Tay/pull/114), adapted from [`fxceless/victory-fork#1407`](https://github.com/fxceless/victory-fork/pull/1407), which credits the original finding to Kelvaroq's `stellarr-studio/kelvaroq` patch 0009. A 48 MiB synthetic regression reproduced the overflow before the fix and passes in debug and Release. This proves the tested partitioning case only; gameplay, rendering, and performance effects are unmeasured.
- `crates/victory-gpu/src/descriptor/host.rs` and `draw.rs`: replace the process-global decoration-bake completion marker with coverage stored on each heap's `TextureQueue` revision. A pass can return a completion token only when it did not overlap another pass, the due and lookahead snapshots were complete, and the pass finished within its budget; the synchronous path certifies only after command execution and descriptor publication. This adapts [`TaynanGT/Vice-Tay#85`](https://github.com/TaynanGT/Vice-Tay/pull/85), commit `7eef143`, merged 2026-11-27. Regression tests cover equal revision values on separate heaps, stale revisions, overlapping passes, and a truncated snapshot. Debug diagnostic tests pass serially (407 passed, 35 ignored), and optimized Release tests pass serially (349 passed, 34 ignored). A parallel test run showed an intermittent unrelated test/process failure; details are in the root progress journal. No gameplay or FPS effect is measured.
- `crates/victory-gpu/src/shadow.rs` (root commit `f0c57bb`): measure waits only when diagnostics-mode acquisition first finds the exact-view cache mutex busy, reporting mean, maximum, and six bounded buckets alongside existing request and allocation counts. Release retains the direct blocking lock without timing or extra atomics. This local O4 observability change does not alter cache contents, resource lifetime, or lock scope; runtime measurements are still required before an optimization is selected.
- `crates/victory-gpu/src/host.rs`: replace the title-derived host-window caption with the neutral dynamic caption `AstraForge | <FPS> | <ms/frame> | <draws/frame>`. This is local branding only; it does not change rendering, frame pacing, or performance measurement semantics.
- `crates/victory-shader/src/emit/{lower,wave}.rs` and `resource.rs`: correct three shader-translation cases from [`TaynanGT/Vice-Tay` merge `708dbfe`](https://github.com/TaynanGT/Vice-Tay/commit/708dbfe7325830d3785846ed24b79e902919a240), PR #229. The changes preserve the collision-register predicate required for inactive Wave32 lanes, decode `v_add_f16` inline constants as half-precision values during wave analysis, and keep root constants as table offsets rather than address bases. Added focused regressions for the half constants and descriptor tracking. Tests and a diagnostic build pass; gameplay image and performance effects are unverified.
- `crates/victory-gpu/src/{host.rs,pipeline/host.rs,pipeline/library.rs}`: bypass persistent pipeline-library reuse for NVIDIA PSOs that contain static samplers, unless `VICTORY_LIBRARY_STATIC_SAMPLERS=1` is explicitly set. The adapter vendor ID comes from the adapter retained by the D3D12 device; other vendors keep the existing library path. Adapted from [`TaynanGT/Vice-Tay` commit `fa8fc1d`](https://github.com/TaynanGT/Vice-Tay/commit/fa8fc1d4691910642d8b487571eaf040aa062c21). The pipeline-library bypass test and host pipeline tests pass; this is a candidate correctness fix, not yet confirmed against the black screen or gameplay.
- `crates/victory-shader/src/{ir.rs,emit/lower.rs,emit/valu_tests.rs}`: size the spill-analysis scalar usage table for all 256 operand codes, so codes above 127 no longer index past it. `s_min`/`s_max` now pass the operand comparison to SCC as the RDNA 2 ISA specifies. Ported from [`TaynanGT/Vice-Tay` merge `dda5a34`](https://github.com/TaynanGT/Vice-Tay/commit/dda5a34324c2125de28ffd494b49098531d39d6d), PR #315, which ports trustno1-coder/VIctory-NVIDIA#53 by illuminatedfellow. The donor's `TRANSLATOR_VERSION` bump is omitted because the local fingerprint hashes all translator sources. Both regressions fail without the fix and pass with it; the shader suite passes 285 with 4 ignored. Gameplay effect is unverified, and the shader cache must be prewarmed again for this build.
- `crates/victory-gpu/src/{host/send.rs,shadow.rs}`: lay out a card copy's sends in a single pass, and return ranges that are already ordered and disjoint from `shadow::joined` without sorting and joining them. What is sent, and where, is unchanged. Ported from [`TaynanGT/Vice-Tay` commit `bb529f1`](https://github.com/TaynanGT/Vice-Tay/commit/bb529f12779f381606dbc93d2e45dd74dc3258b7), PR #286. The `send.rs` hunks apply unchanged; the `joined` early return was adapted by hand. The `host::send` and `shadow::` tests pass (34, 1 ignored). The translator fingerprint is unchanged, so no new prewarm is needed. Gameplay effect not yet measured.

No other upstream source file is intentionally modified. The checkout's upstream commit history is not present because the initial import used a read-only GitHub API snapshot rather than Git transport. Local commits record each focused correction and its tests. Earlier local history records the imported snapshot, Clippy fix, upstream documentation sync, physical-core worker port, dynamic descriptor heap identity guard, in-flight descriptor deferral, launcher cleanup, comment anonymization, and other verified local fixes.
